cards.announcement: Senior QA Engineer - Berlin - adzuna.de Was? Wo? Suche Erweiterte Suche Senior QA Engineer - Berlin ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche Resident Advisor Berlin €60,000 - 72,000 per year Vollzeit SCHNELLBEWERBUNG NEU Auf diesen Job bewerben About RA Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture. Purpose of the role As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co, our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself. Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster. Key responsibilities Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are We’re looking for Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. We use XCUITest on iOS and Espresso with Kotlin on Android Enough coding to write and fix tests alongside developers, in a language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin or Swift You can test APIs and check data with SQL Good judgement about risk: what to test deeply, what lightly, and what not at all You've used AI tools in your testing work, and know where they help and where they don't Clear writing: bug reports and test plans other people can act on If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest. Nice to have CircleCI or a similar CI tool Working with an external testing partner Payments, checkout or ticketing systems Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail What we offer you Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance. Matched pension, or 401k for US staff. Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs. Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch. Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about. A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity). Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community). More about RA We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis. Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it. RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge. We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations. Our values Electronic music is art. We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music. We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community. We honour the past, present and future of electronic music. We use innovation to empower the community. We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit. We're always front left. Listing details This role is a full-time, permanent position, based in Berlin. Please note: this position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary range for this role is €60,000 to €72,000. If you have questions about the role, please contact work@ra.co. This listing will be open for a minimum of two weeks from [date]. Please be sure to add work@ra.co to your contacts and check your junk/spam folder for emails from us. Suche Erweiterte Suche QA Engineer (Mid/Senior) ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche Talon.One Berlin 1000 per year Vollzeit BALDIGER BEWERBUNGSSCHLUSS Auf diesen Job bewerben ABOUT TALON.ONE: Talon.One, an Adyen company, is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, personalized promotions and offer management into a single platform. Built for enterprise scale and security, Talon.One helps businesses design and deliver incentives that drive real customer behavior. Today, over 300 of the world’s most-loved brands including Sephora, Gymshark and Costa Coffee work with Talon.One to turn their incentives into a reliable growth engine. ABOUT THE TEAM: Our Research and Development department is made up of cross-functional teams of Developers, Interaction Designers, QA Engineers, and Documentation specialists, all collaborating under the guidance of Product and Engineering Managers. Each team owns a specific area of our platform. We work with relative autonomy, encourage original ideas, foster professional growth, and believe that quality at every stage is of utmost importance. We’re looking for a QA Engineer who will be an advocate for quality from the very start of the development process. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with all functions to shape testing strategies, ask the right questions early, and ensure that robust test coverage exists as features are developed. Rather than merely focusing on testing completed changes, you’ll embed quality into our development process, championing best practices, improving test automation, and ensuring that great software is continuously delivered. ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL: Become an expert in the Talon.One product, and the foremost expert in the area for which your team is responsible. Collaborate with product, design, and engineering functions to ensure our delivered features are consistently of a high quality. Set the test strategy, engage critically with all functions from the outset of each feature. Ensure we have design and behavioral consistency between features, and strong, efficient test coverage at every level. Determine which test scenarios should be included in our suite of end-to-end automated tests, and implement those using Cypress. Willingness to proactively help junior Quality Engineers, provide timely feedback, and guide them to success. Contribute to Mentorship Programs and onboarding new joiners. WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE: Ability to communicate effectively and clearly in English, and precisely describe complex interactions Ability to architect a strong Test Strategy Strong track record in advocating for quality at all levels of development process 3 - 6+ years of experience delivering quality web applications with test automation, including REST APIs/GraphQL ABOUT TECHNOLOGY: Kubernetes running on Google Cloud PostgreSQL Golang for our API, core logic, and internal tooling TypeScript, React, Redux, and CSS modules for our web application Cypress for automated end-to-end testing WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: A Research and Development Department of 100+ of engineers, product managers and product designers in Berlin Leaders with 8+ years of experience building our promotions engine €1,000 annual learning budget and free German language courses to boost your skills 30 days of annual leave, plus extra paid days for your birthday and moving day Home office setup budget, a monthly home office allowance Freedom to work from abroad for up to 90 days worldwide! Mental health support with nilo.health and a discounted Urban Sports Club membership 20% company subsidy on your pension contributions BVG public transport ticket and welcome your furry friend in our dog-friendly Berlin office! You assure quality across our consumer mobile app and our business web platform, from test design to production monitoring. You build the automation, define what release- ready means, and contribute to the final human sign-off before each release. We build fast with AI-assisted tooling, so independent, rigorous checking matters more than ever. Your work lets every team ship quickly and with confidence. Note: This role is Berlin based. Your Responsibility Design test strategy and acceptance criteria together with development and product Build and maintain mobile and web end-to-end automation and run it in CI Test APIs and backend services, including contract and data validation Run performance, load and security testing across mobile, web and APIs Assist in release validation and the final human sign-off on every release Set up production monitoring and follow findings through to a fix Effectively deploy and use AI agents Your Experience 5+ years in QA automation, site reliability or a closely related engineering role Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript and Python, and a firm grasp of backend, frontend and database concepts Mobile end-to-end automation with Appium, Detox or Maestro on iOS and Android Web end-to-end automation with Playwright; Selenium or Cypress also welcome API, performance and security testing, including OWASP basics, with tools such as Postman and k6 CI pipeline authoring, such as GitLab CI or GitHub Actions, and SQL for data validation Clear bug reports and acceptance criteria that others can act on A valid driving licence (EU category B or equivalent); testing the product includes trips on the road. Highly desired Experience in mobility, logistics or another operations-heavy consumer product Testing payment flows in a consumer or business product Monitoring and observability tooling for production systems Writing test code in Go or another typed backend language GDPR-aware test data handling Accessibility and usability testing Don't tick every box? Get in touch anyway. Your drive to learn and grow matters a lot to us.Benefits Mobility: Choose between monthly MILES credits or the Deutschlandticket. Fitness: Enjoy a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership for your physical and mental well-being. Discounts: Access 1,500+ providers for discounts on sneakers, theater visits, and more. Home Office: Enjoy the flexibility of working from our office in Berlin and from home. Retirement: Secure your financial future with our attractive pension plan. Growth: We prioritize personal development through knowledge sharing and training opportunities (with the support from our HR Team and the Team Leads). Social Impact: We dedicate a portion of our revenue to support regional social projects, actively contributing to the well-being of society and the environment. #milescharity About us OUR VALUES Our MILES values are the basis of our daily work and what makes us a team. They define how we treat each other at MILES and how we strive to bring the best of ourselves to our customers. Here is a brief insight into what you can expect from us in your day-to-day: Passion: Be yourself, have fun, and enjoy what you do. Ownership: Strive for excellence and surprise yourself. Resourceful: Be pragmatic. Use what we have first. Curiosity: Feel free to challenge the status quo and be willing to adapt. Support: Support each other and proactively ask for help. Empathy: Always consider the position others are in. ABOUT MILES We are the leading car sharing provider in Germany and also offer long-term car subscriptions. Thanks to our cooperation and charity activities, part of our turnover goes towards regional and social projects. At MILES, we believe in a world in which mobility is shared, sustainable, and accessible to all. With our offer, we create an alternative to private car ownership, reduce the number of vehicles on the roads, and positively contribute to urban life. Become part of our diverse team, bringing talented people from over 50 countries together, each with their own experiences and ideas. GOOD TO KNOW Don't have a MILES account yet? With the code JOINUS15, you will receive €15 starting credit when you register for the first time. Enjoy the ride!
